# AIMS Training Center

> ACTVET-licensed professional training center in Abu Dhabi, UAE (established 2010) offering 50+ accredited technical, vocational, language, and soft skills courses with over 10,000 graduates.

## Overview

- **Website:** https://aimstrainingcenter.com/
- **Location:** Lulu Express Building, Benkaram Tower - Mezzanine 02, Hamdan Bin Mohammed St, Abu Dhabi, UAE
- **Phone:** +971 2 672 4334
- **Email:** contactus@edu-aims.com
- **Accreditation:** Licensed by ACTVET (Abu Dhabi Centre for Technical and Vocational Education and Training)
- **Formats:** In-person classroom, hands-on computer labs, online live classes, corporate training, and flexible weekday/evening/weekend batches
- **Markdown Negotiation:** Any page on this site supports `Accept: text/markdown` to return a clean, token-efficient Markdown representation.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://aimstrainingcenter.com/): Overview of AIMS Training Center, featured programs, active offers, student stats, and FAQs.
- [All Courses](https://aimstrainingcenter.com/courses/): Complete catalog of 50+ ACTVET-approved training courses across Engineering & CAD, Finance & Accounting, Office Administration, Graphic Design & Animation, IT & Networking, Project Management, Soft Skills, and Languages.
- [About Us](https://aimstrainingcenter.com/about/): Mission, vision, ACTVET licensure, corporate brochure PDF, and center heritage since 2010.
- [Special Offers](https://aimstrainingcenter.com/offers/): Current limited-time course discounts, early-bird savings, and corporate bundle offers.
- [Blogs & Insights](https://aimstrainingcenter.com/blogs/): Exam preparation guides (OET, IELTS) and UAE career development articles.
- [Enroll as Trainer / Student](https://aimstrainingcenter.com/enroll/): Direct enrollment and trainer registration portal.
- [Contact Us](https://aimstrainingcenter.com/contact/): Admissions contact details, Abu Dhabi campus map, and enquiry form.

## Course Tracks & Popular Programs

- [Engineering & CAD](https://aimstrainingcenter.com/courses/engineering-cad/): AutoCAD 2D/3D, Revit Architecture/Structure/MEP, BIM, Civil 3D, 3ds Max, STAAD.Pro, ETABS, SolidWorks.
- [Finance & Accounting](https://aimstrainingcenter.com/courses/finance-accounting/): Tally Prime, QuickBooks, SAP FICO, Peachtree, UAE VAT & Corporate Tax Compliance.
- [Office Administration](https://aimstrainingcenter.com/courses/office-administration/): Advanced MS Excel, MS Office, ICDL Certification, Document Control, Executive Secretarial.
- [Graphic Design & Animation](https://aimstrainingcenter.com/courses/graphic-design-animation/): Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Motion Graphics, 2D/3D Animation.
- [IT & Networking](https://aimstrainingcenter.com/courses/network-it/): Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA A+/Network+/Security+, Cloud Computing, Web Development, Python.
- [Language Courses](https://aimstrainingcenter.com/courses/language-courses/): IELTS Preparation, OET for Healthcare Professionals, PTE Academic, Spoken English, Spoken Arabic.

- [Markdown API](https://aimstrainingcenter.com/api/markdown?path=%2F): Direct Markdown representation of any site route.
